before: Garbage collection reclaims memory of objects no longer reachable, at an unspecified time. It is not a reliable way to close files or other external resources. AutoCloseable lets a resource owner release them deterministically with try-with-resources.

This toy resource prints on close so the ownership boundary is visible without opening a real file. close runs on normal or exceptional block exit. A still-reachable reference and a closed resource are separate concepts; closing is not object deletion.

Expected output or behavior: using
closed
after. Compiler evidence is recorded separately from app reading completion.
Optional local transfer task: Trace close during an exception and distinguish resource cleanup from memory reclamation. You may trace it without a JDK; reading completion is not proof of a local run.
after: An object is reachable while the running program can still get to it. Garbage collection can reclaim memory from unreachable objects, but the time is not promised. Do not rely on it to close files. try-with-resources calls close at a clear point when its block exits.

Closing and memory cleanup are different jobs. A reference may still reach an object after its resource has closed. This practice Session only prints a closing message, so it shows the order without opening a real file.
The program prints using, closed, and after on separate lines. close runs before execution continues after the block; no garbage collection is needed for that order.
The quiz adds another use call inside the same block. The block still manages the same resource and closes it when leaving.

before.question: If the body calls use twice, what still happens?
choices: Two uses prevent close from running.
Garbage collection must run before after can print.
before.explanation: try-with-resources owns closing at block exit, independent of whether use was invoked.

after.question: Call use twice inside the block. What still happens?
choices: The second use prevents close from running.
Garbage collection must run before after can print.
after.explanation: The number of use calls does not change who closes the resource. try-with-resources still calls close when leaving the block.
